selectLanguageDescription: Sarudza mutauro wehunyanzvi hwekuisa nemutauro wakasarudzwa wesaiti.
verifyRequirementsDescription: Tarisa kuti nharaunda yeseva yako inokodzera zvinodikanwa zvekumhanya HAX.
allRequirementsMet: Zvinodikanwa zvose zvazvizere. Unogona kuenderera kune nhanho inotevera.
configureSystemDescription: Gadzira akaundi yako yeadministrator yeHAX saiti nyowani.
passwordHelp: Siya yakashara kupasiwedhi yakachengetedzwa inogadzirwa pachayo, kana kupinda mavara 10+ ane rimwe tsamba nerimwe nharo.
saveCredentialsWarning: Zvakakosha: Chengetedza masiredhiyensi aya zvino. Iyi ndiyo nguva yakaparara yavacharatidzwa.
languageHelp: Nyora zita, zita remuno kana kodhi.
usernameHelp: Mavara, nhamba, dot, dash ne underscore.
versionAfterSignIn: Shanduro yeHAXcms nenzira dzakazara dzeserver zvinoratidzwa mu system admin kana wapinda.
foreverFiles: Masaiti ako mafaira akapusa ari mu_sites, anoteverwa ne git kubva pazuva rekutanga.
foreverStandards: Yakavakwa pamitemo yewebhu, saka zvaunogadzira zvinoramba zvichishanda HAXcms ichigadziridzwa.
foreverPortable: Tora saiti kupi nekupi: inomhanya paHAXcms muPHP kana Node, kana semafaira akamira.
tvArtCredit: Unyanzvi hweFuture Traveler kubva ku haxtheweb/art. TV inoratidzika zvakafanana muchiedza nemurima.
padNote: HAX Blocks pachiteshi 2: kwikwidza nevakwikwidzi vatatu kuti uwane mabhuroko eHAX. A inobata (kana kurova mukwikwidzi ari padhuze newe), B inodzosa imwe, Select inoshandura murwi wako, Start inoburitsa. Keyboard yako inoshandawo: miseve, A na B zvinobatidza bhatani rezvinodzvanya.
tipDifference: Mapeji ako iHTML yemitemo yewebhu mumafaira akapusa aunayo, anoteverwa ne git. Anenge saiti yese yakavakwa neHAX kubva 2020 ichiri kushanda nhasi, uye saiti inofamba pakati peHAXcms muPHP, muNode kana static hosting sezvayakaita. Yakavakirwa kugara, isingaremedzi nyika.
tipFiles: Mushure mekuisa, Unza padashboard inoshandura izvi kuita saiti yeHAX yaunogona kugadzirisa, kugadziridza nekutora kupi nekupi.
tipSites: Nongedza Unza kukero yesaiti uye mapeji ayo anopinda semapeji nemabhuroko eHAX.
tipBooks: Mabhuku akavhurika nemarepo emagwaro-sekodhi anova saiti yeHAX ine rondedzero yawo yakakwana.
tipPassword: Nhanho yekupedzisira inoratidza kupinda kwako kutsva kamwe chete. Kuchengete mupasiwedhi maneja usati watanga HAXcms.
